title: wktest staging build storm-safe deploy pipeline
desc: Storm-safe build+deploy: wkbuild.cmd -> wktest-build/smoke/gc/promote (bin/). Single-file self-contained publish, COPY-promote (never rename), NO .new.exe storm-marker as the deploy trigger, mandatory smoke gate before any hot-swap, built-in GC. Designed so a rookie AI cannot cause a wkappbot-core spawn storm.
steps: ENTRY: wkbuild.cmd is a thin shim to wktest-build.sh. Standard build needs no flags (workspace + single-file publish handled).

BUILD: wktest-build.sh runs dotnet publish as a single-file self-contained exe with SkipDeployCore=true, computes the version from git (rev-list count since the WKAppBotBaseVersion bump commit), stages it as wktest-core-MODEL-vVER.exe, auto-runs smoke, and AUTO-DEPLOYS on smoke PASS by cp -f over wkappbot-core.exe. CRITICAL: it does NOT write a .new.exe -- that FSW hot-swap marker was the spawn-storm trigger, so deploy is a plain copy.

SMOKE: wktest-smoke.sh runs 6 safe checks (version; skill list with junk excluded over the floor; skill read on-load FULL with no developer-only stub; skill search; single-file integrity = no loose wkappbot-core.dll/deps in bin; storm-safety = core-count delta under 10). It uses cmd.exe file redirects not the nul redirect and MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL, and doubles as housekeeping by calling wktest-gc.

PROMOTE: wktest-promote.sh is the ONLY sanctioned hot-swap path -- it REFUSES unless wktest-smoke passes (exit 0) AND the staging exe is a real single-file build (over 50 MB), then COPIES to wkappbot-core.exe plus wkappbot-core.new.exe (the marker a running Eye watches). FORCE=1 bypasses the gate with a loud warning.
GC: wktest-gc.sh keeps the newest N per model and age-gated sweeps old staging binaries; runs on every smoke so no separate schedule is needed.

STORM-SAFETY SUMMARY: no .new.exe as the build output (removed), copy-promote not rename, a mandatory smoke gate at every hot-swap, Defender-rename fallback, and a DEPLOY-BLOCKED message pointing at wkdoctor -DefenderFix when the canonical exe is quarantined.

BUILD ENTRY = ./wkbuild.cmd at REPO ROOT only (2026-06-21). Principle: the legit build script lives at the repo ROOT (core AND sdk); duplicates/imposters deleted. REMOVED: bin/wkbuild.cmd (dup; had made bare 'wkbuild' resolve to bin), wkbuild.sh (root; created the FORBIDDEN .new.exe FSW marker -> 2261-proc spawn storm), bin/wkbuild.sh (launcher-deploy, already built into wktest-build.sh). bare 'wkbuild' is GONE -> run './wkbuild.cmd' from repo root. DIAGNOSIS REFLEX: if a build seems 'slow/hung', check for a LIVE dotnet/msbuild/bash process FIRST -- ZERO build process + empty output + no _pub_ dir = the build NEVER STARTED (dead/orphaned shell), NOT a slow test. Background/detached wkbuild dies instantly (the .cmd->bash child orphans on detach); run ./wkbuild.cmd in FOREGROUND or via the user's own shell '! wkbuild'. Real lag points: dotnet publish (single-file), git log -S pickaxe (version calc), smoke (247MB self-extract) -- put any timeout on SMOKE.

FIX 2026-07-03: bin/wktest-build.sh's Launcher deploy step had 'if [ ! -f "$LP" ]' guarding the dotnet publish call -- if a publish artifact already existed at that path (from any earlier build), it was silently reused even after a real source fix, deploying stale Launcher code. Fixed: publish now always runs unconditionally every build (dotnet publish is internally incremental so an unchanged-source run stays fast).
